caption: The drawing depicts a single object, likely made of metal, resembling a three-legged stand or support. The object consists of a central vertical post that widens slightly at the top and narrows as it moves down. It stands on two curved legs that extend forward and outward from the bottom of the post, forming an arching shape. Attached at the back, a straight horizontal bar extends away from the central post, ending with a right-angle bend that forms a short supporting leg touching the ground. The overall coloration is achieved through pencil shading, giving the object varying shades of gray that indicate texture and highlight the three-dimensional form. The background is plain and unadorned, with a light beige or off-white color, which contrasts with the darker shading of the object. There are no other objects, patterns, or details present in the composition.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
